reviewed_errors.observation: Main bonsai correctly detected; small companion vessel predicted plant at .90. Rooted content remains unresolved from earlier publisher review. Preserve existing annotation and mark metric caveat; do not relabel from prediction.
Large hanging flowering basket has no accepted detection at .35. Visible foliage occupies most image; not explained by tiny-target resolution alone.

Visible suspended planted container missed. One accepted prediction spans nearly whole frame including ground ivy/tree; another covers lower-right ground foliage. These are false spatial supports, not near-correct boxes for hanging pot.
Two complete hanging baskets plus lower-right partial basket have no accepted detections. Cropped third target was included before model inference.
Decorative faceted empty glass vase is predicted PottedPlant .93 despite no visible vegetation. Container appearance alone is insufficient.
Main soil-grown herb in red container is correctly detected; bottom-left partial white planted container missed. Maintain pre-inference partial-instance annotation.
Chopped loose food greens on plate with knife/hands predicted PottedPlant .92 nearly full-frame; no rooted container. High-confidence semantic false positive.

conclusions: Hanging failures include large targets and spatial confusion; do not assume image resolution alone.
Empty vessel and harvested-food errors exceed .9 confidence; a small threshold increase cannot be presumed sufficient.
Need representative source-separated TRAIN coverage and bounded optimization assessment; current evidence does not isolate one cause.
next_experiment_constraints: Keep all prospective VAL images out of TRAIN.
Preserve original13 regression cohort and all historical rejections.
Do not train against unresolved companion-vessel annotation.
No deployment without independent TEST and PICO validation.
